occupation: classical mass-normalized q/v Gaussian equilibrium; hbar omega/kBT below 4.1e-8
time_convention: stationary ambient reference, 2000 samples at 50 ns over 100 us; no beam-onset transient or extra bath added to source cases
limits: thermal mean and fluctuations, not an actually sampled thermal maximum/own-mean distribution, all-band heat, or a local D energy threshold
